evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Apply Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD best practices throughout the full software development lifecycle to ensure quality and speed of delivery; you embrace continuous learning and are energized by working in a fast-paced, innovative environment
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD pairs rigour signals (platform reliability, quality, CI/CD) with explicit velocity language ('fast-paced', 'speed of delivery'), giving roughly equal weight to both, so mixed.
evidence.domain_risk: Swiss Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The employer is a global reinsurance/insurance company, a default-high-risk regulated sector, even though the responsibilities themselves are framed generically as platform-building.
evidence.data_team_maturity: You'll be joining Group Data Services (GDS) at Swiss Re — a forward-thinking team dedicated to building scalable data and AI solutions
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The candidate joins an existing, named data function (GDS) with defined charter and named technologies in responsibilities, indicating a mid-maturity team rather than greenfield or fully specialized/mature.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build end-to-end applications and services for document analytics and information retrieval, ensuring performance and reliability; Hands-on knowledge of SQL, Apache Spark, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in production environments
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific technologies (Spark, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Palantir Foundry) and concrete application domains (document analytics, information retrieval) give the reader a clear picture of the actual work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: building intelligent, scalable platforms that power information retrieval, document analytics, and enterprise knowledge systems
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's primary output is internal data/knowledge infrastructure (document analytics, information retrieval platforms) consumed across the organisation, making internal_data the dominant orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Contribute to solution architecture, driving continuous improvement and platform reliability across the stack; Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into impactful technical solutions
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role contributes to architecture and drives improvement (strategic-leaning) but also translates externally defined business requirements into solutions (execution-leaning), giving a mixed profile.
evidence.ai_role: Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), AI engineering, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques; building scalable data and AI solutions that power information retrieval, document analytics, and enterprise knowledge platforms
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate builds document analytics and information-retrieval infrastructure explicitly described as powering AI/knowledge systems, with LLM/RAG exposure as a nice-to-have — the candidate's output is infrastructure that AI systems run on, which is ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The JD mentions CI/CD pipelines generically but never frames testing, data contracts, or data quality as an owned responsibility or even a listed tool/practice distinct from general software delivery.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Contribute to solution architecture, driving continuous improvement and platform reliability across the stack
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Platform reliability is mentioned as a secondary concern within a delivery-oriented role with no compliance, audit, or regulatory language despite the insurance sector, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Proven experience designing and building scalable, data-intensive applications from the ground up; Contribute to solution architecture, driving continuous improvement
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes explicit greenfield language ('from the ground up') with ongoing improvement/reliability work on an existing platform, so mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: Contribute to solution architecture, driving continuous improvement and platform reliability across the stack - reliability is a stated concern but secondary to delivery and business impact framing.
